name: Sea Trials
description: Take the Aqua Nova through her paces and report to OERA.

objectives.description: Return to 15 m or shallower, so the antenna has a link
Transmit your sea trials report from the Comms station

message.subject: Sea trials: report received
message.text: Report received. Good work, Captain. The ship passes. We are reviewing survey requests for the Atlantic shelf and will send your first assignment soon.

message.subject: Survey assignment: Mystic Reef and Vineyard Ledge
message.text:
Captain,

The Aqua Nova has passed her trials, and the Directorate has your first survey assignment. We want baseline samples from the shelf off Woods Hole before the deep work begins.

Use Remora, the Science ROV, from the Science Lab or the Launch Bay. First, take a water sample at Mystic Reef, right beside the dock, with the spectrometer. Then take the ship about 16 nautical miles south to Vineyard Ledge and drill a rock core. Remora is slow and stays on a tether, so bring the ship close and keep Remora within a nautical mile of it.

Bring both samples to Dr. Patel's lab for analysis, then send us your findings from the Comms station.

Accept the mission when you are ready.

O.E.R.A. Operations Directorate
